translated_title: Mexico Recovers $5.8 Million from the Weinberg-García Luna Network; It Will Go to Guerrero Schools
original_title: México recupera 5.8 mdd de la red Weinberg-García Luna; irán a escuelas de Guerrero
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: The $5.8 million is a first slice of a $578.5 million U.S. judgment against funds the UIF traced through Barbados shell firms like Nunvav on inflated prison contracts.
